answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can influence shared decisions, then cap its voting weight by stake and slash that stake when independent audits confirm coordinated fraud. A juniper-themed agent and a ridge-themed agent can still join, but creating a thousand names does not multiply influence unless the attacker locks up a thousand stakes. The cost is capital tied up for as long as the system requires, plus losses if caught; a slow tide of identities cannot cheaply wash away that constraint.
